designDecisionsAndRationale: Reduced execution payloads (design §3): inputSnapshot subtrees of at least 1024 bytes are stored once per root as sha256 content-addressed fragments ($rielaPayloadRef, _rielaPayloadRefs) and linked by workflow_runtime_payload_refs(root_session_id, parent_digest, digest). This removes the quadratic re-storage of upstream outputs in loop sessions.

Release cascade (design §3.2): a payload row is deleted only under all three NOT EXISTS guards (executions.payload_digest, nested_invocation_refs.digest, payload_refs.digest). Its refs are removed by parent_digest, and children go through the same guarded release. The sweep runs in two bounded rounds. This ensures a shared fragment survives until its last parent is gone.
Write switch (design §3.5): writesReducedExecutionPayloadsByDefault = true, with a test-only task-local override and no user setting.

Doctor (design §6): doctor is strictly read-only and uses a retention dry run. Store root and state directory come from one RetentionTargetResolver lookup on the sessionRoot carried from paths(_:), never from the database parent (runtime-records). remainingBytes is an upper bound.
intentionalTradeoffs: remainingBytes = compactEstimateBytes + pruneEstimateBytes is deliberately not de-duplicated; it is labelled an upper bound.
The benchmark is measured on stored JSONB row lengths on both sides; the refs-table overhead is counted only for the reduced store.
The schema is generation 12, so older binaries refuse the store (downgrade rejection) in exchange for the smaller payloads.
unreferencedPayloadBytes is reported but not added to remainingBytes.
supportedEdgeCases: A fragment shared across executions of one root survives the rewrite or truncation of any one parent.
Nested-invocation ref replacement keeps fragments still referenced by root rows.
Leaked refs rows with a missing parent are swept, and their child fragments are released only if unreferenced.
The doctor finds the maintenance cursor for explicit stores (S/retention) and project stores (<project>/.riela/retention), resolving symlinks such as /var to /private/var.
A store with auto_vacuum=NONE gets a recovery block with requiredFreeBytes = 2*(db+wal)+256MiB.
If there is no cursor, the doctor creates no retention directory.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Cross-root fragment sharing (fragments are root-scoped by design).
New CLI flags or GraphQL/SDL surfaces for doctor fields.
Re-implementation of accepted ssg2 behavior beyond integration-review findings.
